data.claim: The safest protocol separates durability classes: an append-only intent log with strong durability for metadata, and a weakly durable scratch workspace. Reclamation is safe because evidence only exists upon pairing an intent record with a completion certificate in the durable log. Before computation, the process appends an intent record (problem_id, input_hash, lease_nonce) to a strongly durable, single-writer append-only log. The workspace itself is treated as weakly durable scratch. Upon completion, an immutable evidence artifact is written to a separate strongly durable store, and a completion certificate is appended to the intent log. The protocol durably records the intent log and all completion certificates.
